system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 37. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (41 seconds, code score 0.83) ---
[b00] SFX: The harsh scrape and clatter of heavy iron chains dragging across wet stone.
[b01] JULIANA (straining, defiant gasps): "I will not!"
[b02] JULIANA (passionate defiance): "They can take my name. They can take my home."
[b03] JULIANA (indomitable spirit): "They cannot take who I am!"
[b04] NOBLEMAN (quietly skeptical): "Do you think she'll actually be executed?"
[b05] CLARISSA (dismissive, certain): "After what she has been accused of? Of course."
[b06] NOBLEMAN (musing): "She was always stubborn."
[b07] CLARISSA (bitter, cold): "That was her greatest mistake. She could have accepted what happened. She could have disappeared quietly."
[b08] ACTION: Clarissa rises from her armchair holding a cut crystal glass filled with dark red wine, pacing toward the fireplace.
[b09] CLARISSA (venomous monologue): "Instead she married a nobody, played healer to peasants, challenged people above her. And now the whole county will watch her pay for it."
[b10] CLARISSA (chilling proclamation): "Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place."
[b11] ACTION: Clarissa takes a slow sip of the red wine, her eyes gleaming with dark relish.

--- WINDOW 1 (24 seconds, code score 0.79) ---
[b00] SFX: Rhythmic water drips splashing onto stagnant dungeon puddles and a low, mournful ambient drone.
[b01] ACTION: Juliana curls her fingers back, pulling away from the foul sustenance in defiance.
[b02] JULIANA (weak, whispering through tears): "They think hunger will make me surrender."
[b03] JULIANA (fierce resolve): "They think fear will make me beg."
[b04] SFX: The harsh scrape and clatter of heavy iron chains dragging across wet stone.
[b05] JULIANA (straining, defiant gasps): "I will not!"
[b06] JULIANA (passionate defiance): "They can take my name. They can take my home."

--- WINDOW 2 (20 seconds, code score 0.77) ---
[b00] BLOND NOBLEMAN (rupert, cold, calculating): "Every important family in the county should witness it."
[b01] CATHERINE (inquiring, smug): "The wedding?"
[b02] BLOND NOBLEMAN (rupert, authoritative): "The transfer of Ashbridge."
[b03] CATHERINE (gloating): "After the ceremony, no one will question who owns this house."
[b04] BLOND NOBLEMAN (rupert, sinister, ruthless): "And no one will question what happened to the woman who tried to stop us."
[b05] CATHERINE (venomous satisfaction): "Juliana's execution comes after the wedding."

--- WINDOW 3 (22 seconds, code score 0.76) ---
[b00] CLARISSA (chilling, sharp): "Not just an execution. A warning."
[b01] NOBLEMAN (curious): "To whom?"
[b02] CLARISSA (contemptuous, scornful): "To every woman who thinks she can rise above the place she was given."
[b03] CLARISSA (smug triumph): "Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch."
[b04] SFX: Rhythmic water drips splashing onto stagnant dungeon puddles and a low, mournful ambient drone.

Pick the single best promo.
